# GaryTu

> GaryTu is an online art education platform offering comprehensive courses in fashion illustration, watercolor painting, oil painting, design fundamentals, and creative entrepreneurship.

GaryTu provides professional-quality art instruction through 4K video tutorials and detailed course modules. The platform serves both English and Chinese-speaking students with content spanning illustration techniques, color theory, architecture painting, and business skills for artists.

## Core Platform

- [GaryTu Homepage](https://garytu.tw): GaryTu's main homepage featuring online courses, art education, and creative products
- [GaryTu Chinese Homepage](https://garytu.tw/zhtw): GaryTu Chinese homepage with online courses, art education, and merchandise

## Fashion Illustration & Watercolor Courses

- [Fashion Illustration Watercolor - Season 1](https://garytu.tw/online-course/intro/1): Fashion illustration watercolor course introduction with 4K video tutorials
- [Fashion Illustration Watercolor - Season 1 (Chinese)](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/1): Chinese fashion illustration watercolor course introduction with techniques
- [Fashion Illustration - Season 2: Paris Architecture](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/2): Season two fashion illustration course featuring Paris architecture painting
- [Fashion & Luxury Brands Course](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/9): Fashion course featuring luxury brands, editing, and fashion week styling

## Painting & Color Theory Courses

- [Oil Painting & Portrait Techniques](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/12): Oil painting and portrait course with color theory and realistic techniques
- [Color Theory & Watercolor Mixing](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/13): Color theory and watercolor mixing course with pigment guides and harmony
- [Watercolor Architecture & Landscape Painting](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/14): Watercolor architecture and landscape painting course with Barcelona travel

## Design & Drawing Fundamentals

- [Brand Design & Graphic Design Fundamentals](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/3): Brand design and graphic design fundamentals course with color theory
- [Sketch Fundamentals & Figure Drawing](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/15): Sketch fundamentals and figure drawing course using Bargue method

## Creative Business & Entrepreneurship

- [Artist Entrepreneurship & Business](https://garytu.tw/zhtw/online-course/intro/6): Artist entrepreneurship course covering business, marketing, and pricing
